create_flags_instance: create a Flags instance that initializes an argparse.ArgumentParser with core MMF arguments
get_parser: get the configured ArgumentParser from a Flags instance to parse CLI arguments
add_core_args: add core arguments including config_override, local_rank, and opts to the argument parser
use_config_override: use the config_override flag to override MMF config options from the command line
use_local_rank: use the local_rank flag to set the local rank for torch.distributed.launch support
